ex.en: We carried on the discussion till late at night.
ex.zh: 我們一直討論到深夜。

ex.en: It was one of the best nights I've had.
ex.zh: 那是我度過最棒的夜晚之一。

ex.en: Are you afraid of nights with thunder and lightning?
ex.zh: 你怕打雷閃電的夜晚嗎？

night.en: the dark part of each day, when most people sleep

ex.en: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
ex.zh: 叔叔送我一支很漂亮的手錶。

ex.en: This is the nicest present I've ever had.
ex.zh: 這是我收過最好的禮物。

ex.en: "What is the weather like over there?" "It's nice."
ex.zh: 「那邊天氣怎麼樣？」「天氣很好。」

ex.en: Everyone in the office is very nice.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡每個人都很親切。

ex.en: It was nice of you to help me.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我，你人真好。

nice.en: kind and friendly to other people

nice.zh: Nice to meet you：很高興認識你

ex.en: Nice to meet you, Amy.
ex.zh: 艾咪，很高興認識妳。

ex.en: It's nice to meet you in person.
ex.zh: 很高興終於見到你本人。

nice.en: a polite greeting used when you meet someone for the first time

ex.en: Hopefully things will pan out nicely.
ex.zh: 希望事情能順利發展。

ex.en: The new design works nicely.
ex.zh: 新設計效果很好。

nicely.en: in a good or satisfying way

ex.en: If you ask nicely, she might help you.
ex.zh: 如果你好好拜託，她也許會幫你。

ex.en: She was nicely dressed for the interview.
ex.zh: 她為了面試打扮得很得體。

nicely.en: in a polite or attractive way

ex.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
ex.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣是由氧氣和氮氣組成的。

ex.en: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
ex.zh: 植物需要氮才能生長。

nitrogen.en: a gas with no color or smell that makes up most of the air

ex.en: U.S. companies are working to find a niche in the Japanese economy.
ex.zh: 美國公司正努力在日本經濟中找到利基市場。

ex.en: The company found a niche in eco-friendly packaging.
ex.zh: 這家公司在環保包裝找到了利基市場。

niche.en: a small area of business that suits a particular group of customers

niche.zh: 適合自己的位置（工作、角色）

ex.en: She finally found her niche as a teacher.
ex.zh: 她終於在教書這行找到了自己的定位。

ex.en: He's still looking for his niche.
ex.zh: 他還在尋找適合自己的位置。

niche.en: a job or place that suits you very well

ex.en: The district is known for its lively nightlife and late-night cafes.
ex.zh: 這個區域以熱鬧的夜生活和深夜咖啡館聞名。

ex.en: The travel guide highlights the city"s nightlife options.
ex.zh: 旅遊指南介紹了這座城市的夜生活選擇。

nightlife.en: entertainment such as bars and clubs that is available in the evening

ex.en: Taiwan's night market is bustling.
ex.zh: 臺灣的夜市很熱鬧。

ex.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
ex.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尷尬到不行。

night market.en: an outdoor market that opens in the evening and sells food and goods

ex.en: I woke up in the middle of the night after a nightmare.
ex.zh: 我做了惡夢，半夜醒了過來。

ex.en: Finding a parking space downtown is a nightmare.
ex.zh: 在市中心找停車位簡直是場惡夢。

ex.en: The long delay turned our trip into a nightmare.
ex.zh: 長時間的延誤讓我們的旅行變成一場惡夢。

ex.en: The movie ends at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 電影九點結束。

ex.en: Our baby is nine months old now.
ex.zh: 我們的寶寶現在九個月大了。

ex.en: There are nine players on a baseball team.
ex.zh: 一支棒球隊有九名球員。

ex.en: My younger sister just turned nineteen.
ex.zh: 我妹妹剛滿十九歲。

ex.en: There are nineteen students in our small class.
ex.zh: 我們的小班有十九名學生。

ex.en: The train leaves at nineteen minutes past three.
ex.zh: 火車三點十九分發車。

ex.en: The bus ride takes about ninety minutes.
ex.zh: 搭公車大約要九十分鐘。

ex.en: Our neighbor just celebrated his ninetieth birthday; he is ninety now.
ex.zh: 我們鄰居剛過了九十大壽，他現在九十歲了。

ex.en: She got ninety points on the final exam.
ex.zh: 她期末考拿了九十分。

ex.en: Nigel is a name used mostly in Britain.
ex.zh: 奈傑爾是主要在英國使用的名字。

ex.en: Nigel waited at the station with a large suitcase.
ex.zh: 奈傑爾提著一個大行李箱在車站等候。

ex.en: The museum was built in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 這間博物館建於十九世紀。

ex.en: Our team finished nineteenth out of twenty in the race.
ex.zh: 我們的隊伍在比賽中二十隊裡排第十九。

ex.en: Nick offered to drive us home after the party.
ex.zh: 尼克提議派對後開車送我們回家。

ex.en: I will ask Nick whether he wants to join us.
ex.zh: 我會問問尼克想不想加入我們。

ex.en: There is a small nick on the edge of this plate.
ex.zh: 這個盤子的邊緣有一道小缺口。

ex.en: He cut himself shaving and got a nick on his chin.
ex.zh: 他刮鬍子時割傷了自己，下巴上多了一道小傷口。

ex.en: Someone nicked my bike while I was in the shop.
ex.zh: 我在店裡的時候，有人把我的腳踏車偷走了。

ex.en: He got caught trying to nick a few sweets from the store.
ex.zh: 他想從店裡偷幾顆糖，結果被抓到了。

nick.zh: 千鈞一髮之際（in the nick of time）

ex.en: We got to the station in the nick of time and caught the train.
ex.zh: 我們在最後一刻趕到車站，搭上了火車。

ex.en: The rescue team arrived in the nick of time.
ex.zh: 救援隊在千鈞一髮之際趕到了。

ex.en: Nicholas is saving money to buy a new bicycle.
ex.zh: 尼古拉斯正在存錢買一輛新腳踏車。

ex.en: Nicholas waved to us from across the street.
ex.zh: 尼古拉斯在街的另一頭向我們揮手。

ex.en: Our office is on the ninth floor of the building.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在大樓的九樓。

ex.en: She finished ninth in the city's marathon.
ex.zh: 她在市馬拉松賽中跑了第九名。

ex.en: The ninth of May is my brother's birthday.
ex.zh: 五月九日是我哥哥的生日。

ex.en: A ninth of the cake was left on the plate.
ex.zh: 盤子裡剩下蛋糕的九分之一。

ex.en: He ate only a ninth of the pizza and gave the rest away.
ex.zh: 他只吃了披薩的九分之一，其餘的都送人了。

ex.en: His nickname at school was Tiny because he was so tall.
ex.zh: 他在學校的綽號叫「小不點」，因為他長得很高。

ex.en: Everyone in our family uses her nickname instead of her real name.
ex.zh: 我們家的每個人都叫她的暱稱，而不是本名。

ex.en: Do you have a nickname that your friends use?
ex.zh: 你有朋友會叫的暱稱嗎？

ex.en: My classmates nicknamed me Speedy after the race.
ex.zh: 比賽之後，同學們給我取了「飛毛腿」的綽號。

ex.en: The fans nicknamed the new stadium the Bowl.
ex.zh: 球迷們給這座新球場取了個綽號叫「大碗」。

ex.en: The match ended three nil.
ex.zh: 比賽以三比零結束。

ex.en: The chances of finding the key are almost nil.
ex.zh: 找到鑰匙的機會幾乎為零。

ex.en: Nigeria is a large country in West Africa.
ex.zh: 奈及利亞是西非的一個大國。

ex.en: Lagos is a busy port city in Nigeria.
ex.zh: 拉哥斯是奈及利亞一座繁忙的港口城市。

ex.en: Nicola is a girl's name in the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: Nicola 在英國是女孩名字。

ex.en: Nicola took the early train to London.
ex.zh: 尼古拉搭早班火車去倫敦。

ex.en: Farmers use nitrate to help plants grow.
ex.zh: 農夫使用硝酸鹽幫助植物生長。

ex.en: Too much nitrate in the water can harm fish.
ex.zh: 水中硝酸鹽太多可能傷害魚類。

ex.en: My niece just started primary school.
ex.zh: 我的姪女剛上小學。

ex.en: I bought a gift for my niece's birthday.
ex.zh: 我為姪女的生日買了一份禮物。

ex.en: Nickel is often used to make stainless steel.
ex.zh: 鎳常被用來製造不鏽鋼。

ex.en: Some people are allergic to jewelry that contains nickel.
ex.zh: 有些人對含鎳的首飾過敏。

ex.en: He found a nickel on the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 他在人行道上撿到一枚五分錢硬幣。

ex.en: A nickel is worth five cents in the United States.
ex.zh: 在美國，一個 nickel 價值五美分。

ex.en: They danced all night at a nightclub downtown.
ex.zh: 他們在市中心一家夜店跳了一整晚的舞。

ex.en: The nightclub is too loud for me.
ex.zh: 那間夜店對我來說太吵了。

ex.en: The nightly news starts at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 每晚的新聞九點開始。

ex.en: He takes a nightly walk around the park.
ex.zh: 他每晚都繞著公園散步。

ex.en: The show runs nightly at eight.
ex.zh: 這場表演每晚八點上演。

ex.en: The streets are cleaned nightly.
ex.zh: 街道每晚都會清掃。

ex.en: Nicaragua is a country in Central America.
ex.zh: 尼加拉瓜是中美洲的一個國家。

ex.en: Nicaragua has many lakes and volcanoes.
ex.zh: 尼加拉瓜有許多湖泊和火山。

ex.en: The puppy nipped my finger while we were playing.
ex.zh: 小狗在玩的時候輕咬了我的手指。

ex.en: Be careful not to nip your hand in the door.
ex.zh: 小心別讓手被門夾到。

ex.en: I'm going to nip out to the shop for some milk.
ex.zh: 我要快速到店裡買點牛奶。

ex.en: Can you nip upstairs and get my glasses?
ex.zh: 你可以快點上樓幫我拿眼鏡嗎？

ex.en: There was a nip in the air this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上空氣中有一股寒意。

ex.en: He took a small nip of whisky to warm himself.
ex.zh: 他喝了一小口威士忌暖身。

ex.en: Nighttime temperatures drop quickly in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠的夜間氣溫下降得很快。

ex.en: The nighttime sky was full of stars.
ex.zh: 夜空裡佈滿了星星。

ex.en: I don't like driving alone during nighttime.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡在夜間獨自開車。
